_comment: Read scope for Marty's tools in the dashboard chat pane (tools/marty_tools.py) and for tools/vault_index.py and tools/media.py. Read-only: nothing here grants a write. Paths are checked after resolve(), so '..' cannot walk out of a root. A path must sit inside an allowed root AND match no denied pattern. The 18 numbered projects moved out of OneDrive to C:/Users/{{WIN_USER}}/Projects on 2026-10-04; they are listed one by one so the rest of that folder (Personal, Career, Security Incident, {{CONTACT_NAME_1}} Projects and others) stays out of scope. marty_tools.py adds its own CLOUD_DENY on top (the Secure Folder and its own log), because whatever a tool reads there is sent to Anthropic. If this file is missing or unreadable, nothing is authorized.
_vision_model: The local Ollama model see_image and see_video_frame send one downscaled frame to; it must be vision-capable. null means none is installed (marty-local is mistral-nemo, text-only): both tools then return a plain error saying so, run nothing, and never fall back to a cloud model. To enable them, install a vision model with Ollama and put its name here; the next message picks it up, no restart.
